Kotlin standard library (kotlin-stdlib) is transitively pulled by okhttp. CloudShare is a pure Java application and does not use Kotlin code or features at runtime. Any compiler or build-time vulnerabilities mapped to the Kotlin CPE are not applicable to CloudShare.

CVE-2026-66299 is an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in Tomcat's WebSocket chat example application. Spring Boot's embedded Tomcat container does not deploy or package Tomcat's "examples" web application in any environment. Since the affected example application is completely absent from CloudShare's deployment, this CVE is inapplicable.
